entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4094784475310672128: position at J2016.0. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, WZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1619.8 +/- 47 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1619.8 +/- 47 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.5742 +/- 0.0277 mas (same row, RUWE 0.94), 20.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.979, -0.224 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 108.5 +/- 3.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, WZ Sgr: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 108.5 +/- 3.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4875 +/- 189 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 266, Name='WZ Sgr', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 189 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic).

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,875 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.431 +/- 0.011 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe4cb. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,875 K and log g 1.22 (u1 0.655, u2 0.121): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 1.22 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 13 published values span log g 0.4 to 1.85, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.3% of the centre brightness.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4094784475310672128: 4 G-band harmonics of a 21.847478201912878 d period, peak-to-peak 0.790 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.13 of a cycle there.
